review_scope: Static narrow review only; runner not executed; no model, fit, inference, metric calculation, checkpoint load, or raw-feature read.
review_basis: The frozen runner/protocol SHA values match the requested values; all six source SHA values match protocol bindings. OOF and calibration CSV headers match the fields consumed; source lengths/cell counts are 22281/42 and 4567/10, and true_RUL values are positive.

Static logic uses exactly 42 fit-cell policy vectors for equal-cell mean and population SD (ddof=0), drops SD<=1e-12 columns and stops on calibration deviation >1e-10 C, then sorts exact float64 squared standardized distances by (distance, cell ID) and selects five source cells per calibration cell.

Each local residual distribution is built only from OOF rows of the selected five source cells with cell mass 1/5 and row mass 1/(5*ncell); exact Fraction left-inverse quantiles .1/.5/.9 are median-centered once, preserving saved point median. Calibration labels are only used in the final per-cell metrics and gate calculations.

Primary gate is the frozen saved-fixed-sigma comparison with unchanged point MAE, interval-score reduction >=5%, paired-cell bootstrap CI lower bound >0, mean per-cell coverage-error reduction >=.03, aggregate coverage error nonworsening, >=7 improved cells, width ratio <=2, mean Brier increment <=.002, and coherent bounds/no crossings. Global OOF CDF is secondary and cannot rescue primary failure.

Protocol explicitly limits estimates to one train-only transform and ten neighbor/CDF estimates, with zero fits, inference, raw-feature/checkpoint/development/test reads; limitations identify exposed calibration, event-only scope, unknown physical/source identity, and 28-fit versus 42-fit residual transfer.
preGO_execution_conditions: This is a pre-GO review. The coordinator must issue a fresh exact GO after this PASS; before execution the runner must validate GO status, this receipt status and SHA, frozen source/input hashes, owner/lock and all project gates. This PASS waives none of those gates. The prior three OOF fit starts remain consumed and are not repeated.
